description.value: Sabzi Mandi Supermarket is a 100% family-owned South Asian grocery chain with 15 locations across British Columbia, built around a wide selection of fresh fruits and vegetables, specialty international groceries, and hard-to-find ingredients sourced locally and globally. Founded in the early 1990s to serve Metro Vancouver's large South Asian community, the chain carries its own imported Sabzi Mandi and Roshni brand products alongside household items and cooking appliances. It operates as a full-service supermarket, making it a practical resupply option for touring cyclists passing through Surrey.
